topic: how YouTube ads alone brought in nearly as much as all of Netflix
storyAngle: One part of Google's ad machine is almost the size of the whole streaming giant.
doNotClaim: Both are 2024 revenue figures; revenue is not profit.

say: thirty six point one billion dollars
